content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a self-owned digital commerce stack. It combines free and paid tools to create a fully operational online store that processes payments, delivers products, and stores data without relying on third-party platforms. For Pakistani creators, this means bypassing the limitations of Stripe, PayPal, and local gateways. The core components include hosting (GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages), backend logic (Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script), order storage (Supabase or Google Sheets), file delivery (Google Drive or Cloudflare R2), and payment processing (NOWPayments for crypto). This architecture is designed to be resilient, cost-effective, and entirely under your control. You deploy it once, own it forever, and operate without recurring fees or geographic restrictions. It’s not a temporary fix—it’s a permanent solution built for creators who refuse to be locked out of global markets.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack begins with hosting. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve your storefront—static HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which process orders, verify payments, and trigger product delivery. Orders are stored in Supabase (a serverless database) or Google Sheets for simplicity. Product files are hosted on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring fast, secure delivery. Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee and no KYC. When a buyer pays, NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain and fires a webhook to your backend, triggering instant product delivery. The entire system is automated, secure, and designed to operate without your ongoing intervention. You deploy it, and it runs—no matter where your buyers are located.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is built for digital creators in Pakistan and similar regions who are excluded from global payment systems. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, software, or any digital product, this stack is for you. It’s also for creators who value ownership over convenience. You own the code, the data, and the deployment—COREMERCH has no access after delivery. This isn’t a platform you rent; it’s infrastructure you own. It’s pressure-tested in environments like Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and financial isolation are realities. If you’re tired of payment rejections, high fees, or geographic restrictions, this is your solution. It’s built for creators who choose sovereignty over dependency.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure eliminates geographic payment restrictions entirely.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component in the stack serves a specific purpose. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide free, reliable hosting for your storefront. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, ensuring your store operates smoothly. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data securely and efficiently. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver your digital products instantly and reliably. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and automatic webhook integration. These tools are chosen for their cost-effectiveness, scalability, and ease of use. Together, they form a cohesive system that eliminates the need for third-party platforms. The result is a commerce stack that works anywhere, for anyone, without restrictions.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing the stack that fits your needs. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) deploys in 48 hours and includes GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments with 3 products loaded. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) uses Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, with 5 products loaded and email security configured. If you prefer to build it yourself, The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) provides complete documentation, source code, and a scaling playbook. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to choose your path. Once deployed, you own the infrastructure. No subscriptions. No recurring fees. Just sovereign commerce that works—anywhere, for anyone. This is how you stop renting and start owning.

Store order data: Use Supabase or Google Sheets for secure, scalable storage. 5. Deliver products: Host files on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for instant delivery. 6. Integrate payments: Set up NOWPayments for crypto processing with automatic webhooks. 7. Test end-to-end: Ensure all components work seamlessly before going live. 8. Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not technical?

Yes. The Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack are deployed for you in 48 hours. If you prefer to build it yourself, The Sovereign Blueprint includes step-by-step documentation and source code.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Binance Coin, and stablecoins like USDT. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON.
Do I need to pay recurring fees after deployment?
No. Once deployed, you own the infrastructure. There are no subscriptions or recurring fees. The only cost is NOWPayments’ 0.5% transaction fee for crypto payments.
Can buyers purchase without a crypto wallet?
Yes. NOWPayments does not require buyers to have an account. They can pay using any supported cryptocurrency directly from their wallet or exchange.
What happens if I need support after deployment?
The Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack include 30-day support. For DIY deployments, The Sovereign Blueprint provides full documentation and a scaling playbook.
